name: Bases Link Graph
changes: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
Adds optional trackpad pan and pinch controls.
Keeps checkbox values typed when the graph reads mixed properties.
changes_user: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
You can now pan and zoom the graph with trackpad gestures.
Checkbox values keep their type when the graph reads mixed properties.
tip: Right-click a node and choose Show only notes near this one to limit depth with Pro.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Bases Link Graph is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it with Bases. Bases is still new, and your setups teach me a lot.
